summary: Emo River Airstrip is a small rural airfield serving the community of Emo Mission in Papua New Guinea's Northern Province. The airstrip primarily supports missionary operations, local transport, and access to remote villages along the Emo River system. With a size score indicating modest infrastructure, it functions as a vital link for residents and aid workers in this otherwise road-isolated region.
